headline: AI Agent Autonomy and Security Gain Momentum
summary: Cloudflare's Clef and Clef-flash models and Apple's enhanced Full Disk Access controls are pushing the boundaries of AI agent autonomy and security, indicating a growing focus on reducing human oversight and enhancing user safety.
whyItMatters: This trend underscores the industry's commitment to developing more autonomous AI agents while prioritizing user security, which is crucial for widespread adoption and trust.
